optapps_csm: Hey team — OptiApps is seeing 1,500 promotional credits on their Org dashboard but when they call the Usage API with their service key the billing shows zero credits applied and they're getting charged. Service key: sk-prod-xyZ9. Can we triage?

ava_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact service key header + a sample request they used? Also which project/org id they see credits on in the Console?

optapps_csm: They see credits at org level: org_0712 (Org name: OptiApps). Project their integration uses: project-197 (service key attached to that project in the UI). Sample request they sent: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/text-gen-4/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xyZ9" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":20}'
```

Response headers include: 

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-usage-credits-applied: 0
```

miguel_billing: I pulled metering for that service key for the last 24h. Looks like tokens are being recorded under a different project tag: project_id = proj_0x9a (which maps to a legacy project name). Query I ran: 

```sql
SELECT project_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_used
FROM usage_events
WHERE service_key = 'sk-prod-xyZ9'
  AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY project_id;
```

Result: 

```
project_id | tokens_used
------------+-----------
proj_0x9a   | 124560
```

ava_support: Hmm — in the Console the credits are attached to org_0712 and to project-197. Miguel, is proj_0x9a linked to org_0712 or a different org?

miguel_billing: proj_0x9a currently maps to org_0299 (old migration leftover). So the credits are visible on org_0712 UI but the metering events are attributed to proj_0x9a/org_0299, so the credit engine never applied the org-level promo.

sasha_sre: Possible causes: service key was re-assigned during project migration or there was a stale project mapping cache in the frontend. Can we see the service key history? Logan, can you check the key assignment logs?

logan_engineer: Looking now. Key history shows: 

- 2025-11-03 14:12 UTC: sk-prod-xyZ9 created for project-197
- 2026-01-08 09:44 UTC: internal migration job remapped some project IDs; a cleanup job failed for sk-prod-xyZ9 and it wasn't re-tagged.

I can temporarily re-tag the live events for the last 72h to project-197 to unblock billing; persistent fix will be to run project-mapping-resync across the migration shard.

ava_support: Before making changes, can we reproduce locally with a minimal request and verify x-usage-credits-applied header semantics? Also customer asked for immediate relief rather than waiting for a resync.

miguel_billing: For immediate relief: we can issue a promo override applied to service key sk-prod-xyZ9 (applies credits for events with that key regardless of project tag) and then kick off the resync. I propose: 
- Apply temporary override of 1,500 credits to sk-prod-xyZ9 
- Run backfill to reassign events in usage_events for ts > now()-72h from proj_0x9a -> project-197
- Re-run billing simulation and finalize refunds if needed

optapps_csm: Customer accepts temporary override and wants confirmation when refunds (if any) are issued. They also said they can pause traffic for an hour if needed.

sasha_sre: I'll coordinate. Quick repro steps for devs: 
1) Use their service key in a post to completions
2) Check header x-usage-credits-applied and x-project-id returned by the metering proxy
3) Inspect metering pipeline message: 

```json
{"service_key":"sk-prod-xyZ9","project_id":"proj_0x9a","tokens":12}
```

logan_engineer: Backfill plan enqueued: job id fb-2026-03-17-88. Estimated runtime 12min for 72h window. Applying temporary override now.

billing-bot: [AUTOMATED] Credit override applied: 1500 credits -> sk-prod-xyZ9 by miguel_billing at 2026-03-17T15:04:22Z :white_check_mark:

miguel_billing: Backfill started. I'll monitor and post the before/after token attribution.

ava_support: Updated the customer: "We've applied a temporary credit override and started a backfill to fix the project mapping. We'll confirm when the backfill finishes and whether a refund is due." They replied :thumbsup:.

miguel_billing: Backfill finished. Re-attributed 124,560 tokens from proj_0x9a -> project-197 for ts window. Billing simulation shows 1,490 credits consumed (small rounding diff). I'll create a refund for the overcharge of $0.42 and issue it within 48h.

optapps_csm: Customer notified and very happy with the quick turnaround. They asked for root cause note and steps to avoid recurrence.

sasha_sre: Root cause summary we'll send to customer: stale migration cleanup left a subset of service keys on legacy project tags (proj_0x9a) while Console grant logic updated org-level promo to org_0712. Migration cleanup script failed for a shard; fix is: run project-mapping-resync across shard, add a healthcheck to ensure keys have consistent project_id in both keystore + metering mapper, and add a small end-to-end test that verifies x-project-id in metering messages matches Console mapping after key reassignments.

ava_support: I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem and include the refund note + steps we took. Closing thread once postmortem and refund ticket are created.

miguel_billing: Refund ticket #RB-3247 opened. ETA refund processed: 2026-03-19.

optapps_csm: Thanks everyone. :tada:
